comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Costa Rica’s decision to abolish its army is one of those historical choices that becomes more interesting when you see what followed over decades. 🇨🇷🌿 Investing heavily in education, healthcare and conservation helped shape a very different national identity from many countries in the region. What stands out is how environmental protection eventually became not only a cultural value, but also an important part of the economy.

replies.author: @PrimeTravel2
replies.text: Beautifully said! 🌿 Costa Rica is a fascinating example of how long-term decisions can shape a country's identity and future. Its approach to conservation is especially interesting because it connects nature protection with both national values and the economy. Thanks for sharing your thoughts! 🙏
